question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at 'PQ' as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d4187c5a51e23659f25f61e004ccee66169f23745fec1e427d1ff76bca57c2.png]
solution:
When the mirror is placed vertically to the object, the mirror image so formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the **Right Hand Side **and Left Hand Sid**e** interchange their positions while top and bottom will remain same.

The mirror image of the question figure is as follows:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b9d286d4c9f56daa0c20577c6b69014603a53f566b3029a7f1d6ae88a51414c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
